messages:
Tyler (Sales): @Jen quick heads-up — AcmeGov just confirmed they want to start the POC next week but procurement needs a clean order form + signature path. They flagged two blockers: 1) DPA/KMS clause (they require HSM attestation) 2) pricing cadence for Dedicated reserved capacity. :wave:
Jen (Legal): on it. can you paste the orderform they uploaded? want to check if there's any extra indemnity language.
Tyler (Sales): pasted below — they attached a simple order summary in the portal: 

```
PO: AG-PO-2026-443
Amount: $48,000 (6-month reserved capacity)
Model: dedicated-8xA100
Term: 6 months
Special: KMS-HSM attestation required; DPA redline requested by customer security team
```

Kai (Solutions): @Elaine for pricing — customer asked whether we can split the commit into quarterly invoices. also want to confirm start-of-term billing vs usage start.
Elaine (Finance): Quarterly invoicing is possible but needs approval. forward the PO and I'll run the billing impact. if they want start-of-term billing delayed to usage start, that becomes a prepay vs. billable credit conversation.
Alex (Security): tagging in from the security questionnaire side — the KMS/HSM ask: do we have a standard attestation doc we can provide, or do they want on-paper attestation? I can provide our KMS architecture and SOC2 excerpt.
Jen (Legal): thanks. small checklist from me: 1) DPA — remove paragraph that permits subprocessors to store unredacted customer data in third countries? we usually limit to necessary subprocessors. 2) Add HSM attestation appendix — we can provide standard language but customer asked for vendor-signed attestation. Do we have a standard addendum?
Tyler (Sales): customer reps want signature routing that goes to their procurement + legal (two signers). prefer DocuSign but they also accept emailed signed pdf. they asked for countersign to be completed within 5 business days.
Kai (Solutions): quick templating idea: include a one-page "POC Bill of Materials" that lists GPU hours, reserved v. burst hours, monitoring credits, and contact for escalation. that'll help procurement map costs.
Jen (Legal): i'll draft DPA redline and the HSM addendum. can someone drop the exact portal upload (signed PO) link? need to attach.
Tyler (Sales): here's the portal link: https://portal.redwood.ai/uploads/AG-PO-2026-443.pdf :eyes:
Elaine (Finance): noted. once I have the signed PO copy and the invoice cadence (quarterly vs monthly) I can approve the split and send vendor billing instructions.
Alex (Security): also — they'll ask for encryption-at-rest key ownership. we should confirm we support customer-managed keys in the Private deployment. if this is Hosted/Dedicated we may offer BYO-KMS with HSM-backed keys for Dedicated customers.
Jen (Legal): good point. Tyler, ask them whether the POC will run in Dedicated (their stated preference) or Hosted. that affects the addendum.
Tyler (Sales): asked them — their PM says Dedicated is preferred.
redwood-bot: deployment-note: canary pool for dedicated-8xA100 currently has 12% spare capacity in us-west-2.
Kai (Solutions): perfect. action items: 1) Jen will send initial DPA redline + HSM attestation addendum by EOD. 2) Elaine will confirm quarterly invoice flow after PO copy + cadence confirmation. 3) Alex to send KMS architecture blurb and SOC2 excerpt. 4) Tyler to confirm countersign path and deadline with customer procurement (DocuSign vs pdf).
Tyler (Sales): thanks team — I'll ping procurement and confirm countersign and return ETA. please @me when redlines are up. :thumbsup:
Jen (Legal): will do.
Alex (Security): posting KMS blurb in a follow-up thread with attachments.
Elaine (Finance): will queue billing approval once PO pdf lands.
Tyler (Sales): last note from customer: they want a one-page SLA summary for the POC (latency p90, uptime target, fallback plan). Kai, can you draft a short SLA excerpt we can append to the orderform?
Kai (Solutions): yes — I'll draft a one-pager and share by tomorrow morning.
Tyler (Sales): awesome. closing thread for now.
